name: bubble
description: Displays conversational content in a message bubble with variants, alignment, grouping, and reactions.
purpose: Frames chat text, short structured replies, and reactions as a self-contained surface without owning the full message chrome.
bestFor: compact reaction rows on a message
avoidFor: full chat interfaces that need avatars, names, and timestamps
long documents that belong in a page section
